title: Live stream: frame and request size limits, 16 outstanding requests (INVENTED)
description:
Epic mimid-e64f; docs/design/binary-live-stream.md §5.4, §5.8.

Chosen by the agent for mimid-e64f, unattended (INVENTED, NOT FROM SPEC):
- maxMessageBytes = 16 MiB + 64 KiB: no frame in either direction is larger; fits an Upload or FetchAsset answer of the largest blob mimid stores (MAX_BLOB_LEN, 16 MiB).
- maxRequestBytes = 4 MiB + 64 KiB: no client request other than Upload is larger; fits the largest MLS object mimid takes on any other route (MAX_BODY_LEN, 4 MiB), as JMAP maxSizeRequest does after base64url.
- A frame over either: Error tooLarge without id, connection closed. A text frame closes the connection.
- At most 16 outstanding requests per connection; one more is answered rateLimited.
Both limits are stated in ProviderHello.
